scope: Full Blowfish algorithm article only; no completion claim for Twofish, DES, AES, bcrypt, modes of operation or the whole library.

coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 Blowfish 这一种 64 位分组密码：16 轮 Feistel 网络、18 项（P1–P18）32 位 P 数组与四个 256 项 S-box、由 pi 十六进制数字初始化的密钥扩展、可变密钥长度、34 条 ECB 向量和 64 位块边界；不把 Twofish、DES、AES、bcrypt 或工作模式并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the Blowfish 64-bit block cipher: 16-round Feistel network, 18-entry P-array and four 256-entry S-boxes, pi-derived key expansion, variable key length, 34 ECB vectors and the 64-bit block bound. It does not absorb Twofish, DES, AES, bcrypt or a mode of operation.
